text: The city should rebuild the central park playground. The playground boasts a design that uses impact-absorbing surfacing, surpassing the safety code, which is crucial for child protection. Moreover, the climbing forest concept is unique, offering a thrilling and engaging environment for kids. A regional grant ensures that materials for the rebuild will be covered if work starts this year, further reducing financial risk. The successful rebuild of the harbor playground serves as a precedent, demonstrating the positive impact of a well-planned and executed playground. By focusing on safety, reliability, and engaging design, the city can create a playground that will benefit the community for years to come.
